decisions.briefing: Markets were roughly flat-to-slightly-down today (NASDAQ -0.6%, S&P 500 -0.3%), a neutral session overall. Three candidates — ACN, STNG, and GFS — showed perfect momentum scores with full multi-signal confirmation (bullish RSI, MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20, and volume surge), so we used open slots and idle cash above the $500 threshold to add diversified exposure despite the muted broader tape.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today, with the NASDAQ down 0.6% and the S&P 500 down 0.3%, consistent with a quiet, directionless session rather than any broad risk-off move. Despite the flat macro backdrop, several individual names showed strong stock-specific technical setups, underscoring that company-level momentum can diverge from the index trend. No major market-moving headlines were identified for today's session.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Multi-signal confirmation means only acting on a trade when several independent indicators — like RSI, MACD, price vs. moving average, and volume — all point the same direction at once. This reduces the chance of chasing a random price blip and increases confidence that real buying interest (often institutional) is behind the move.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 多重訊號確認是指只有在多個獨立指標（例如RSI、MACD、股價相對於移動平均線的位置，以及成交量）同時指向同一方向時，才採取交易行動。這樣可以降低追逐隨機價格波動的風險，並提高判斷背後存在真實（通常是機構）買盤的信心。
